_comment: Lighting anchor table (v0.9). Two independent sliders, each with four named stops; the projector tint = interpolated time-of-day tint (brightness folded into RGB) × interpolated season bias. Tints are [r,g,b] (values may exceed 1.0 for a mild boost under multiply). Edit here to retune lighting without touching code; session_state.gd falls back to built-in defaults if this file is absent or malformed.
